what_to_do.en: Tap the word with a blend.

stages.choice_rule: Four different lowercase whole words taken from the stem. Exactly one has a consonant blend. Vary which slot holds the answer.

gold_items.stem: My brother has a red shoe.
My dad can stop at the top.

roots: Exactly one word in the stem has a consonant blend, and that word is the correct choice.
Give four lowercase whole-word choices copied from the stem. The other three words have no consonant blend.
A blend is two or three consonant sounds side by side, and each sound is heard, at the start or at the end.
Initial blends include bl, cl, fl, gl, pl, sl, br, cr, dr, fr, gr, pr, tr, sc, sk, sm, sn, sp, st, sw, scr, spr, and str.
Final blends include ft, ld, lk, lp, lt, mp, nd, nt, sk, and st.
The spellings sh, ch, th, wh, ck, and ng are digraphs with one sound. Vowel teams such as ee, ay, and igh stay with the vowel.
Silent letters in kn and wr stay silent, so those pairs are one sound. R-controlled or, ar, er, ir, and ur stay with the vowel.
Tier 1 distractors are short words such as can, hop, dog, and red, with no digraph beside them.
Tier 2 distractors include a digraph word from the stem, such as sheep, shoe, she, or white.
Tier 3 distractors include a near miss that drops one consonant, such as top beside stop or mile beside smile.
Every stem word comes from the roots word list or allowed_extra_words, except the token <NAME>. Personal names use <NAME>.

tier_rules.1: Stems of four or five words with a one-syllable initial blend. Distractors are short familiar words with no blend and no digraph.
tier_rules.2: Stems of four to seven words. Use a two-syllable blend word or a final blend, and include one digraph distractor from the stem.
tier_rules.3: Use a near-miss distractor that drops one consonant from the blend word. Keep a single right answer and at most ten words.

l_blend.en: Look for a consonant plus l. You hear both sounds, as in play, flag, and sleep.
l_blend.ko: 자음 뒤에 l이 있습니다. play, flag, sleep처럼 두 소리가 납니다.

r_blend.en: Look for a consonant plus r. You hear both sounds, as in frog and brother.
r_blend.ko: 자음 뒤에 r이 있습니다. frog, brother처럼 두 소리가 납니다.

s_blend.en: Look for s plus another consonant. You hear both sounds, as in stop and smile.
s_blend.ko: s 뒤에 다른 자음이 있습니다. stop, smile처럼 두 소리가 납니다.

final_blend.en: Look at the end of the word. Two consonants there are both heard, as in left.
final_blend.ko: 단어 끝을 보세요. left처럼 자음 두 소리가 모두 납니다.
